headline: Congress in recess mode—both chambers convening briefly Thursday in pro forma sessions

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate held a brief pro forma session on Monday, August 17, meeting at 1:30 p.m. and adjourning within minutes. No legislative action occurred.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met briefly on Monday, August 17 at 9 a.m., adjourning at 9:08 a.m. Nine public bills and one resolution were introduced for the record. No votes were held.
